interpretation: Exploratory retrospective rolling-origin evidence. Historical targets belonged to the prior study training period; not an untouched external or prospective holdout.
source_target: Positive recorded transaction sales in original UCI Online Retail II; demand proxy, not latent demand
old_test_policy: 2011-11-11 through 2011-12-08 stays previously exposed diagnostic; never reevaluated or used to select these models.
eligibility_policy: Freeze fold SKU catalog from days strictly before validation. Retain discontinued/zero-test items; no future-based exclusions.
point_selection: Lowest validation seven-day cumulative WAPE, exact ties by listed candidate order. If validation actual total is zero, lowest absolute error. Select each fold solely on its preceding validation window. No test-based replacement or grid tuning.
primary_metric: WAPE of seven-day total per item and non-overlapping weekly origin
quantile_selection: Lowest mean validation pinball loss over q0.1/0.5/0.9 on seven-day totals; ties choose smaller window. Empirical inverted-CDF order statistic, no outcome-based recalibration.
uncertainty: 400 paired bootstrap replicates; globally shared SKU resampling and fold-block resampling preserve seven-day forecast trajectories. Descriptive, only eight fold blocks and one retailer.
synthetic_inventory_policy: Any stock, arrivals, cost, lead time and actual stockout labels remain separately declared hypothetical inputs. No actual shortage accuracy or savings claim.
resource_policy: One process, one BLAS thread, NumPy-only, no GPU or paid API.
promotion_policy: No operational model promotion from this exposed-data study. Freeze a future candidate only after descriptive results; require unseen operational transaction/stock/arrival evaluation before deployment claims.
portability_note: Source path replaced by explicit --data argument; candidate grid, folds and selection unchanged.
